topicName: Urban Growth in LICs and NEEs

cards.front: Recall a key point about Urban Growth in LICs and NEEs
cards.back: Lagos is a megacity in Nigeria, West Africa. It is built on the coast of the Gulf of Guinea and on islands in Lagos Lagoon. With a population of approximately 15 million (metropolitan area), it is the largest city in sub-Saharan Africa and Nigeria's economic capital. Lagos grows by an estimated 77 people per hour.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Urban Growth in LICs and NEEs
cards.back: Lagos was a small town of approximately 300,000 in 1950. By 2025, the metropolitan population is approximately 15 million - a 50-fold increase in 75 years. Projections suggest it could reach 25 million by 2035.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Urban Growth in LICs and NEEs
cards.back: When assessing urban planning, always evaluate whether strategies benefit ALL residents or just the wealthy. Eko Atlantic is often criticised for ignoring the needs of the 60% who live in slums. The best answers show understanding of inequality in urban planning.

cards.back: 1. For Urban Growth in LICs and NEEs questions, always name specific case studies with factual detail 2.
